name: MSSQL Server Failed Logon From External Network
description: Detects failed logon attempts from clients with external network IP to an MSSQL server. This can be a sign of a bruteforce attack.
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.channel:Application AND ((winlog.provider_name:*MSSQL* AND event.code:18456) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Data:(*CLIENT\:\ 10.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.16.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.17.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.18.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.19.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.20.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.21.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.22.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.23.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.24.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.25.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.26.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.27.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.28.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.29.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.30.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 172.31.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 192.168.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 127.* OR *CLIENT\:\ 169.254.*))))
